title: The Mega Backdoor Roth: $43,500 Tax-Free Nobody Told You
hook: Most people think they've maxed out their retirement accounts — but there's a third door worth $43,500 a year that nobody told you about.
angle: This isn't generic 'max your 401k' advice. It exposes a little-known provision that lets high earners stuff $43,500 more into a Roth account every year — six times the normal Roth IRA limit. Only 20% of employers offer it and almost nobody knows to ask.
audience: High earners 30-50 who have already maxed their regular retirement accounts
key_numbers: $43,500 — extra Roth contribution via mega backdoor
20% — companies that allow in-plan Roth conversion
$4,000,000+ — lifetime tax-free growth potential over 30 years
